name: Contabo
summary: Unmanaged cloud VPS, virtual dedicated and bare-metal servers with a lot of RAM and CPU per plan, unlimited traffic under fair use, and data centres in Europe, the US, Asia and Australia.
best_for: developers and small teams who are comfortable running their own Linux server and want the most RAM and CPU for the money, and can commit to a longer term
skip_if: you want managed hosting with backups included, or you need a server for a short project without prepaying
honest_knock: The advertised prices are for a 24-month term, and that term is prepaid: the Cloud VPS 12 configurator asked €480.00 upfront. Month-to-month costs about 25% more. Backups (€6.70 a month on that size), Windows Server, cPanel and Plesk are paid add-ons, and the servers are unmanaged. Traffic is unlimited only under a fair-use policy that lets Contabo throttle heavy users. Prices on the page exclude VAT. We have not used Contabo ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Cloud VPS 4 · per month on a 24-month term, excluding VAT, 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB SSD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-08 on contabo.com/en/vps and contabo.com/en/pricing in a browser render from a Netherlands connection, EUR, excluding VAT; the site has its own currency selector) The Core Cloud VPS line is priced for a 24-month term: Cloud VPS 4 (4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB SSD, 200 Mbit/s port) €4.40 a month, Cloud VPS 6 (6 vCPU, 12 GB, 200 GB SSD or 100 GB NVMe, 300 Mbit/s) €6.00, Cloud VPS 8 (8 vCPU, 24 GB) €11.20, Cloud VPS 12 (12 vCPU, 48 GB) €20.00, Cloud VPS 16 (16 vCPU, 64 GB) €29.60 and Cloud VPS 18 (18 vCPU, 96 GB) €39.20. In the configurator for Cloud VPS 12 the term changes the price: 1 month €25.00, 12 months €21.25 (save 15%), 24 months €20.00 (save 20%), with no setup fee on any term; the 24-month term is prepaid, €480.00 due today. Add-ons in that configurator: a United Kingdom location €5.80 a month (EU free), Windows Server €53.00, cPanel €21.75, Plesk with Linux €12.00, Auto Backup €6.70 a month and double storage €6.00. Every Cloud VPS has unlimited traffic under a fair-use policy (Contabo may throttle servers whose traffic is exceptionally high), DDoS protection, a firewall and IPv4 and IPv6. The pricing page also lists Performance VPS (Cloud VPS Plus 4 from €10.80), virtual dedicated servers (Cloud VDS S from €39.20) and dedicated servers (from €109.65 as a limited offer), all quoted for a 24-month term.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: Add-ons in that configurator: a United Kingdom location €5.80 a month (EU free), Windows Server €53.00, cPanel €21.75, Plesk with Linux €12.00, Auto Backup €6.70 a month and double storage €6.00.

compare_with.name: DigitalOcean
compare_with.why: DigitalOcean is in our dossiers too and bills its servers by the hour with no term, plus managed databases and app hosting around them. Contabo gives much more RAM and CPU per euro, but its best prices need a prepaid 24-month term and backups cost extra.
